clue.text: Thanks given to a poet for old clothing

parts.note: TA is informal British for thank you
a bard is a poet, as Shakespeare is the Bard

explanation.surface: Someone tips a poet for an old garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tabard is a sleeveless tunic worn by medieval heralds and knights over their armour.

clue.text: Tangled hair the Spanish collect

parts.note: EL is the Spanish word for 'the'
to flock is to gather or collect together

explanation.surface: Spaniards gather up a mess of matted hair.
explanation.definitionFit: An elf-lock is a knot of matted hair, once blamed on mischievous elves tangling it overnight.

clue.text: Is it used by the neat writer?

definitions.text: Is it used by the neat writer?

parts.words: Is it used by the neat writer?
parts.note: neat is an old word for cattle, and a writer uses a pen, so the neat writer's tool is a pen for oxen: an enclosure for livestock

explanation.surface: A question about what a tidy author writes with.
explanation.definitionFit: An enclosure where livestock are kept is called a pen, and neat once meant oxen.

clue.text: The balance mounts

definitions.meaning: a weighing instrument, a pair of pans on a beam
climbs, as one ascends a wall or a mountain

explanation.definitionFit: A balance for weighing is a pair of scales, and one who climbs a cliff scales it.

clue.text: Pay in advance

parts.note: taken as written
to advance is to come forward

explanation.surface: Wages handed over before the work is done.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnings or salary received is one's income; pay is what comes in.

clue.text: The dreamer is idle at work

indicators.note: at work suggests the letters are busy being put into a new order

explanation.surface: A visionary lounges about when he should be at work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'work' rearranges the eight letters of 'is idle at'.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who pursues perfect visions rather than practical aims is a dreamer.

clue.text: Load a vehicle before travel

parts.note: a car is a motor vehicle
to go is to travel

explanation.surface: Packing up the car before a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods carried by a ship or lorry make up its freight or load.

clue.text: Plant many with a gardening tool

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a great many
and means together with
a rake is a toothed tool for gathering leaves

explanation.surface: A gardener sets out lots of seedlings armed with a rake.
explanation.definitionFit: The mandrake is a Mediterranean herb with a forked root, famed in folklore.

clue.text: A nice arrangement after all — so compact

indicators.note: after says the rearranged piece follows the word all

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: an arrangement suggests the letters of 'A nice' being put in a new order

explanation.surface: A tidy layout, all neatly packed.
explanation.walkthrough: Compact here is a noun meaning a pact, not an adjective meaning small.
explanation.definitionFit: A compact is a formal agreement, and an alliance is a pact between parties.

clue.text: Sporting but tiresome

definitions.meaning: having on, as one sports a tie

explanation.definitionFit: Sporting a hat means having it on, and a wearying day is tiring.

clue.text: Share a charge in retirement

indicators.note: retiring means drawing back, so the word for the charge is read backwards

parts.note: a toll is a charge for using a road or bridge

explanation.surface: A pensioner splitting up a fee.
explanation.definitionFit: To share out is to distribute or apportion portions.

clue.text: Bad performers

parts.note: read not as poor actors but as people who perform wicked deeds

explanation.surface: Second-rate actors on the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrongdoers or villains are those who commit wicked acts.

clue.text: Some may have to change their doctor

indicators.note: some of these words means only part of them supplies the letters

explanation.surface: Pet owners may need to switch the person who treats their animals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' takes the letters from inside 'have to'; the rest of the clue dresses the scene.
explanation.definitionFit: A veterinary surgeon is an animal doctor.

clue.text: Get less iron

explanation.definitionFit: To diminish is to fall in number, and pressing clothes removes their creases.

clue.text: Dash this stoppage!

definitions.meaning: a mild exclamation of annoyance, like 'Damn!'

explanation.definitionFit: 'Strike me!' is an oath like 'Dash it!', and an industrial walkout halts work.

clue.text: Will's trial meant trouble

definitions.note: read as 'Will is', a will being the definition

parts.note: a test is a trial

indicators.note: trouble suggests disturbing the letters of meant into a new order

explanation.surface: Will's court case caused him difficulty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trouble' turns MEANT into AMENT. The 's is 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A last will is a legal document disposing of property after death.

clue.text: Depression about a rebel failing

indicators.note: about means the hollow wraps around the rebel's name

parts.note: a dent is a small hollow or depression
Jack Cade led a rebellion in Kent in 1450

explanation.surface: A slump in mood around a rebel's defeat.
explanation.definitionFit: Something in decline or moral decay is deteriorating, as a decadent empire.

clue.text: Big spenders should include a tip

indicators.note: include means the letters sit within the words before it

explanation.surface: Generous diners ought to add a gratuity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should include' points inside 'spenders'. Tip is the end of something, not a gratuity.
explanation.definitionFit: The tip of a stick is its extremity.

clue.text: Aggravates school head? That's not called for!

parts.note: needles means irritates or provokes

indicators.note: head picks the first letter of the word school

explanation.surface: Pestering the headmaster is uncalled for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'school head' looks like a headteacher being needled, but it is the first letter of 'school'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unnecessary or uncalled for is superfluous.

clue.text: A goddess's tea-break

indicators.note: breaking the word tea apart and putting it together differently

explanation.surface: A goddess pauses for a cuppa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' rearranges TEA. Ate was the Greek goddess of folly and ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Ate personifies reckless delusion and ruin.

clue.text: Polish soldiers first-class

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
fine means excellent

explanation.surface: Excellent troops from Poland.
explanation.definitionFit: To polish is to perfect or improve, removing impurities.

clue.text: A club hanger-on

definitions.meaning: a stick used in cricket or baseball
a creature that hangs upside down to roost

explanation.definitionFit: A cricket club is wielded by a batsman, and the flying mammal roosts hanging upside down.

clue.text: The artist splitting ten between two

indicators.note: between says the rearranged letters sit inside the word for two

parts.note: a pair is two

indicators.note: splitting the word ten breaks it up so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An artist dividing ten among two people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'splitting' is the anagram signal for 'ten', and 'between' places the result inside the word for two; 'The artist' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A painter is an artist who works in oils or watercolour.

clue.text: Summary of a sailing man's dissertation

parts.note: AB is an able-bodied seaman, and the 's makes it ABS
a tract is a treatise or dissertation

explanation.surface: A précis of a sailor's thesis.
explanation.definitionFit: An abstract is a short summary of a paper's contents.

clue.text: Superior teetotaller surrounded by alcoholic drink

indicators.note: surrounded by means the abstainer sits inside the drink

parts.note: beer is an alcoholic drink
TT stands for teetotal

explanation.surface: An abstainer stuck among drinkers feels superior.
explanation.definitionFit: Better means of higher quality, a comparative of good.

clue.text: Childish complaint for a bird

definitions.meaning: a fungal infection common in babies
a songbird such as the song bird of gardens

explanation.definitionFit: Oral candida infection in infants has the same name as a speckled songbird.

clue.text: Hoping to get a seat, he'll stand

definitions.text: Hoping to get a seat, he'll stand

parts.words: Hoping to get a seat, he'll stand
parts.note: seems to be a passenger on a crowded train, but the seat is in Parliament and standing means running for election

explanation.surface: A commuter on a full train waits on his feet for a seat.
explanation.definitionFit: A contender for election stands for a parliamentary seat.

clue.text: Crazy about the right sort of drawing

indicators.note: about means the silly word goes around the letter

parts.note: daft means silly or crazy

explanation.surface: A mad picture of the correct kind.
explanation.definitionFit: A preliminary sketch or plan is a rough version of a design.

clue.text: A person with gold and a landed estate

parts.note: a man is a person
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A rich fellow who owns land.
explanation.definitionFit: A manor is a country house with lands, held by a lord.

clue.text: Humiliated scholars caught in the act

indicators.note: caught in means the graduates sit inside the word for act

parts.note: a deed is an act
BAs are Bachelors of Arts, graduates

explanation.surface: Students shamed when caught red-handed.
explanation.definitionFit: Debased means degraded or lowered in dignity.

clue.text: Illiberality puts a woman in some difficulty

indicators.note: in places the woman's name inside the word for trouble

parts.note: a mess is a difficult situation
Anne is a woman's name

explanation.surface: A woman gets someone into trouble by being stingy.
explanation.definitionFit: Illiberality is a lack of generosity, stinginess.

clue.text: Countries where tastes appear strange

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of tastes are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: Lands where people have peculiar preferences.
explanation.definitionFit: Nations or countries are sovereign states.
